one_line: Number each buying criterion and show it on the product with a macro shot.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a woman with a baby on her hip, a small mic at her chin, three story-reply screenshots below. Top headline: 'כל האימהות בסטורי שכנעו אותי', then 'שהגיע הזמן'. She asks (transcript) if it is time to change carriers.
q1_hook.why: Other mothers' story replies as social proof plus a personal question open a gap: why switch (H5, S6). A person speaks to the lens with synced text from frame one (H4, H6, T3). The reply bubbles sit in the lower half and are too small to read (T4).

beats.what: Standing with the baby, story replies below; 'כל האימהות בסטורי שכנעו אותי'
beats.why: Social proof and a question at once.

beats.what: On a sofa, baby on her lap; 'זה לא התינוק שלי שגדל', 'עשה לי כאבי גב'
beats.why: A pain story makes the buyer's worry personal.

beats.what: Cross-legged, baby behind her; 'אז איך תדעי מה זה מנשא טוב?', 'את זה אני הולכת להדגים'
'1 בד ארוג 100% ביו-כותנה', a fabric macro, the carrier worn
beats.why: Tip 1: a macro makes the claim visible.

beats.what: '2 מתאים לשלבי התפתחות שונים', macros of snaps and buckle
beats.why: Tip 2: hands show how it adjusts.

beats.what: '3 מנח פיזיולוגי בצורת M'; she wears it, lifts the legs: 'כשהברכיים גבוהות מהאגן'
beats.why: Tip 3, the one the caption calls most important.

beats.what: '4 התאמה מדויקת למבנה גוף': waist belt, padded straps, back view
'5 אפשרות נשיאה מלפנים ועל הגב', then '6 מעוצב ויפה'
beats.why: Last tips, front and back carry with a smile.

beats.what: Whip-pan to an outdoor walk; 'בקיצור, מנשא Neko Switch הוא כל מה שצריך'; a shop phone mockup

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None to comment, save or send in the video. The caption teases tip 3 as the most important and speaks to pregnant viewers ('ואם את בהריון... הרווחת'), which invites a send. No comment word.
q2_flow.why: A pain story and a promise to demonstrate open a loop that six numbered tips close (H5, K2). Each tip alternates a macro with the carrier worn, a shot every 1 to 3 s, which keeps facts inside action (R3, E2). Six tips in 55 s is a lot, but a checklist is save-worthy (R2, R7).

q3_cta.what: At 0:52 (said, transcript, and shown): 'להשיג בלעדית אצל LUNALU Babies' over a phone mockup of the shop site, 0:52 to 0:55. Caption: 'תשקיעי כבר מההתחלה במנשא איכותי' and the brand named. No link, code or comment word.
q3_cta.why: One action, where to buy, said and shown after the value (C1, C6). But there is no link, code or keyword, and the prices in the mockup are unreadable (S3). The line sits at about 83% of the frame height, in the bottom 35% (F2).

q4_shown.what: Story replies 0:00; a clip of her old carrier 0:08; the green carrier: a fabric macro 0:14, snaps and buckle macros 0:19 to 0:25, worn with the baby 0:26 to 0:37, straps adjusted 0:38, front and back carry 0:44; a shop mockup 0:52.
q4_shown.why: Each criterion is shown on the product at once, as a macro then on her body, with a child in it (S1, F4, F5). Her own back pain and the story replies are first-hand vouching (S6). 'Knees above the hips' is shown by lifting the legs (K4). The mockup's prices are unreadable (S3).

q5_edit.what: About 30 shots in 55 s (about 1.9 s each), straight cuts alternating macros and medium shots; a whip-pan at 0:48 to an outdoor selfie walk; a phone mockup flies in at 0:52. A big number and heading per tip. Ends on the mockup.
q5_edit.why: Cuts every 2 s on the voice keep the pace without confusing the scene (E2, R3). Numbered headings make each tip easy to find and revisit (R7, T3). It ends right after the CTA (E8). At 55 s it is long for a list (R2).

q6_topic.what: How to choose a baby carrier: six checks from a mother who nearly gave up after back pain. Serves pregnant and new parents about to buy one.
q6_topic.why: A purchase in a named life moment, pregnancy and the first year, with a first-hand pain story (K6, K7). The practical list is wrapped in that story (K4). '99% of parents miss this' and 'guaranteed 10000%' in the caption are hype without a source (K6).

q7_filmed.what: Phone on a tripod, static, eye level, in a bright white-panelled room with a mirror and sofa; macros of fabric, snaps and buckles; she wears the carrier with a baby, side, front and back views; a handheld outdoor selfie walk.
q7_filmed.why: Macros and hands fill the frame so fabric and hardware read on a phone (F4, F5). Eye contact in a clean, well-lit room looks personal (F6, F7). The outdoor walk adds real use, but its whip-pan is a blur (H8).

q8_text.on_screen: Top headline word by word: 'כל האימהות בסטורי שכנעו אותי' (0:00). Large white bold numbers 1 to 6 with a heading and a small subtitle line at about 64 to 80% of the frame height: '1 בד ארוג 100% ביו-כותנה' (0:13), '2 מתאים לשלבי התפתחות שונים' (0:18), '3 מנח פיזיולוגי בצורת M' (0:28), '4 התאמה מדויקת' (0:38), '5 אפשרות נשיאה' (0:44), '6 מעוצב ויפה' (0:48). End: 'להשיג בלעדית אצל LUNALU'.
q8_text.caption: '99% מההורים מפספסים את זה כשהם קונים מנשא! 👀', then 'אבל טיפ מס' 3 הוא הדבר הכי חשוב!!!' and 'בשיתוף @lunalu_babies' in the first lines. Long, about 190 words: her story, a note to pregnant viewers, 'מבטיחה לך ב־10000%', five generic hashtags. No question.
q8_text.why: Numbered headings make the list scannable and work muted (T1, T3), but they sit in the bottom 35%, and the subtitle lines are small (T4, F2, T5). The caption hooks with a hype number, and puts 'בשיתוף' in the first lines, a good disclosure (T8, S7). The hashtags are generic (T7).

weak_points: Headings and story bubbles in the bottom band; '99% of parents' and '10000%' unsourced; six tips in 55 s; positioning claims stated as fact; no link or code at the end.
lumebook_takeaway: 'How to choose a personalised book': numbered points, one macro page shot each, a short personal story first, one where-to-buy line last. Hands only.
not_verified: Whether the voiceover was recorded separately for the macro and wide shots (her mouth is not visible). The shop prices (unreadable). The paid-partnership label (0 per media info). Correction: the first headline sits at the top of the frame, and the numbered headings sit at about 64 to 80% of the frame height, in the bottom band. Lead edit 18 Oct: resolution remarks removed, because the downloaded copy can be smaller than what was posted.
